title: Hampton studio session in Los Angeles, August 1955
summary: Numbers rehearsed from nightly playing; Buddy Rich on drums.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: I mean, Chuck Beatty's still in the band. It's August 2nd, 1955.
This is in LA. Oh, yeah, yeah.
This looks like a book for Fleur.
Yeah, yeah. Book Cleft and later for Ver.
I wonder if some of them are known, but Buddy Rich played drums. Do they have his name down there?
Yeah, right. Buddy Rich did play drums on some of these. This looks like a studio. Yeah, it is a studio.
With, gee, Flying Home, Air Mail Special, Midnight Sun, Red River, Baby Don't Love Me No More, Swingin' on Sea, Pig Ears and Rice.
Were these numbers that Hampton did, that you all did live, or were these just things you did for the studio? No, we did live.
No, no. We rehearsed them. We had been playing those numbers every night, but they hadn't recorded them. It's a Blue World, is that on there? Yep, it's a Blue World.
